blocks.tamil_translation: He will not look at them. Rather, He looks only at your hearts and your deeds,” the Prophet ﷺ said, Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The pleasure of Allah Ta'ala is not decided on the basis of your forms and your wealth. Rather, it is decided by looking at your hearts and your deeds, and at how much pure intention there was in the heart.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّمَا اْلاَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ، وَاِنَّمَا لِامْرِءٍ مَا نَوَي، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ اِلَي اللهِ وَرَسُوْلِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ اِلَي اللهِ وَرَسُوْلِهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ اِلَي دُنْيَا يُصِيْبُهَا اَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ اِلَي مَا هَاجَرَ اِلَيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب النية في الايمان، رقم:٦٦٨٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “The rewards of all deeds are decided only on the basis of the intention, and a person will get only what he intends. So whoever made Hijrat (migrated) for Allah Ta'ala and for His Rasul, whoever made Hijrat (migrated) with no aim other than the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala and His Rasul, will get the reward of that Hijrat. Whoever made Hijrat for a worldly aim, or to marry a woman, (his Hijrat will not be for Allah Ta'ala and His Rasul; moreover) whatever other aim he made Hijrat for, his Hijrat will be decided (even with Allah Ta'ala) as being for that aim,” Rasulullah ﷺ said, Hazrat Umar ibn Khattab (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِنَّمَا يُبْعَثُ النَّاسُ
